opening: It has been getting worse; it's worse now than when it began.
It began two years after I started vismodegib, about 8 years ago, as loose stools two or three times a day.
My sense of taste has changed.
I've taken vismodegib 150 mg every day for 10 years.
I have basal cell carcinoma that is locally advanced and has spread (metastatic).

opening.text: I have basal cell carcinoma that is locally advanced and has spread, and I have Gorlin syndrome. I've taken vismodegib 150 mg every day for 10 years. About 8 years ago, two years after I started the medication, I began having loose stools two or three times a day. It has been getting worse since then, and now I have watery diarrhea. I've also had hair loss, my sense of taste has changed, and I get muscle spasms.
